verdict.rationale: Raygun documents its own per-deployment tracking to spot new errors or regressions, a Deployments API, and filtering errors by version. Together these cover only a thin slice of release health. Nothing in the evidence shows crash-free session or user rates, per-release adoption, or a side-by-side canary-versus-stable comparison. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, release adoption tracking, canary vs last-stable release comparison, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one

citations.quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
use smart filters to segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser, and custom tags.
You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API
